items.headline: Assessing South Carolina's redemption win vs. Florida
items.description: The SEC Now crew express pride in the Gamecocks' performance after redeeming themselves against the Gators as they give credit to the defense for the victory.

items.headline: Easton Royal, top WR in '27, flips to Florida from Texas
items.description: Five-star wide receiver prospect Easton Royal has flipped his commitment to Florida, his family told ESPN on Sunday. The New Orleans native is the top-ranked wide receiver and No. 8 overall prospect in the SC Next ESPN 300.

items.headline: LaNorris Sellers sparks South Carolina rout of No. 16 Florida
items.description: LaNorris Sellers accounted for five TDs as South Carolina stunned No. 16 Florida to end an eight-game SEC skid and take some heat off embattled coach Shane Beamer.
